gpuVsyncQualification.scope: Launch/measurement/trace qualification only; not evidence of a performance fix or physical scanout.

scope: Desktop only, artificial native-ABI joystick, no physical phone or Launcher multiplayer qualification. Uncalibrated added diagnostic numeric copies. The selected build is recorded per raw. Any production source differences across runs require the separate build-identity comparison.

cpuThrottle.scope: openProbe and after-open counters precede CPU throttling; subsequent netplay setup and first game callback use the configured per-side rates.

parameters.nativeFrontierObservation: Release pacing ABI sampled on every retained game callback, independently of optional RAF diagnostics

graphicsIdentity.scope: Actual captured core/canvas/existing context after openProbe and before CPU throttling; same-owner read repeated inside the existing failure snapshot. Missing references are unavailable, never inferred from requested browser flags.

renderWork.source: Same onGameFrame th09_game_metrics uint32[10] pointer as samples[11] presentations
renderWork.scope: Optional numeric copies per retained callback, not per simulated frame; uint32 wrap or regression requires separate intervals. No extra draw/tick or per-frame GPU query/readback; these counters are not GPU timings.

touchInput.scope: Synthetic native ABI events on an independent Page clock; not a Launcher/iOS bridge or physical phone test

gpuVsyncControl.scope: Optional single-flag browser diagnostic; addedArgs are launch intent only. Explicit 0/1 requires two verified normal Chrome processes with distinct PIDs and qualified actual argv; unset retains default launch and qualification behavior.

measurementEndpoint.scope: stats/hash/audited/sdl/audio/memory/route aliases are frozen after workload completion, before trace drain. RTC query has separate request/completion clocks and identities. postDrain is a later live observation, not a recertification of the frozen selected route. teardownClean covers that observation before browser disposal, not disposal itself.

headedLaunch.scope: Window-mode environment control with the optional declared GPU-vsync diagnostic. Proxy, input, audio/context, CPU setup and GPU backend selection are unchanged; see gpuVsyncControl for added args and actual argv qualification.

passScope: Measured workload and frozen endpoint gates; clean post-drain state is reported separately by teardownClean.

headedControl.scope: Only the two browsers created by this harness. CDP supplies the unique browser PID; CIM reads only that PID. Save only command-line SHA256 and allowlisted flags, never raw command lines, executable/profile paths, or process lists. Missing identity observation is explicit and cannot establish a matched environment control. Window bounds, visibility/focus and existing lifecycle events do not prove physical scanout, continuous foreground visibility, or non-overlap. No window is moved or brought to front.

scopes.body: Every original sample in [first frontier >= startFrame, first frontier >= endFrame); no phase or rewound-cursor filtering. Without a terminal crossing the observed body is right-censored.
scopes.progress: Closed Hz and cumulative counter deltas use endpoint minus start, including the endpoint counters. The endpoint callback cost belongs to tail; body cost includes start. Missing native frontier uses explicitly labelled observed next high-water, never captures, and complete stays false.
scopes.gaps: Top-level gap fields retain body-only submission/RAF timestamp semantics. formalWithEndBoundary also closes through the terminal marker. Cross-boundary intervals and all sampled startup/tail costs remain separate. No sample is removed from raw results.
scopes.timing: callbackCompletionGapMs is the post-native sampledAt gap between renderer submissions, not whole observer callback return; RAF timestamps and submissions are not physical scanout.
scopes.phase: scenes is a compatibility alias of sessionPhases (SessionPhase, not internal MatchScene); no phase is excluded.
scopes.capture: captures is a once-only input-capture counter and may be ahead of simulation completion; it never chooses boundaries.
scopes.nativeWork: callbackWorkMs is the existing native game callback measurement, not total JavaScript observer time or GPU completion.

routeEvidence.scope: Frozen post-workload endpoint. Native capture and asynchronous RTC query are not atomic; request/completion identities and Page clock brackets are retained. No IP/SDP. This is not the current route after trace drain.

configuration.cadence: Absolute Page-clock grid throughout one held gesture; leg/control edges and terminal neutral retain their own deadlines.

forward.criterion: Adjacent body callbacks, session phase 1 on both, delta next=1/corrections=0/resimulated=0/local input captures=1. Not a guarantee of exactly one attempted tick. Whole callback wall time; workload differs across independent Page-clock runs.

pacing.scope: All chronological body callbacks; each native row indexed into the sample array.
